newsitem.title: USA: Lloyd's of London says it reached Arizona Accord.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's of London says it reached Arizona Accord.

text.p: - Lloyd's of London said on Monday that it has reached an agreement with the State of Arizona, representing a final resolution of all claims and disputes arising from participation of Arizona Names in the Lloyd's market.

The agreement extends to Arizona Names the benefits of an accord reached between Lloyd's and the Coordinating Committee of the North American Securities Administrators Association (NASAA) earlier this year.

Arizona is the last U.S. state to sign a state agreement with Lloyd's. Forty seven other states and the District of Columbia had previously signed agreements. All 2,900 U.S. Names resident in the United States are now covered by state agreements.
As a result of these agreements, U.S. resident Names who have accepted Lloyd's $5 billion settlement offer will benefit from additional relief from their debts.
